title: Generalized Predictive Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: single-view video prediction: 6 future frames at 2Hz, 256x448, from two conditioning frames

control_signal.value: text made of a high-level command and a scene context description; in the action-conditioned extension, the future ego trajectory

control_mechanism.value: text through frozen CLIP encoders and conditional cross-attention with classifier-free guidance (text dropped at p=0.1); trajectory Fourier-embedded, linearly projected, added to the conditions and injected via cross-attention

base_model.value: SDXL image diffusion fine-tuned on driving, then frozen, with added temporal reasoning blocks (causal temporal attention, decoupled spatial attention, zero init) trained for video prediction

datasets.value: OpenDV-2K (over 2000 hours of web driving video with text); nuScenes for action conditioning and planning; zero-shot on Waymo, KITTI, Cityscapes, OpenDV-YouTube

metrics.value: FID, FVD, CLIPSIM, action prediction error via an inverse dynamics model, and ADE and FDE for planning

controllability_evidence.value: No action-error or language-control number in the packet. Reported: nuScenes FID 15.4 and FVD 184 for GenAD (OpenDV-2K); planning ADE 1.23 and FDE 2.31 with a frozen encoder.

closed_loop.value: no, open-loop only: each prediction generates 6 future frames from 2 observed frames; planning evaluated open-loop on nuScenes

stated_limitations.value: BLIP-2 captions are short, poorly aligned and unaware of ego intention; SDXL is slow and costly to sample; training and real-time deployment are demanding.

notes: Primary contribution is a large-scale generalizing predictor; control by text command is shown in the overview figure, but its quantitative test is not in the packet. Action conditioning is a fine-tuned extension on nuScenes.
